title: John jumps the traffic jam in the new Roadster

narrator.description: Calm, friendly, a little playful, quick pace, neutral accent

john.description: Friendly young guy; calm, a little proud

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: If you put John in Elon Musk's new Roadster and hit the SpaceX thrusters, he can jump over the traffic jam. Sort of.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: But he only clears three cars and lands on a bus. So you tilt the thrusters to forty-five degrees, the best angle for a long jump.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: But the jam is ten blocks long. So John uses the suction fan to drive up a building and jumps from the roof.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: But the car spins wildly in the air. So small side thrusters fire to keep it steady, like a rocket.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: But he's coming down way too fast. So the thrusters fire down for a soft landing, just like a SpaceX rocket.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Congratulations, John jumped the whole traffic jam.

lines.speaker: john
lines.text: Well... it did need a wash.
